method: Read all224Japanese paragraphs274–301, compare both k/d bodies and source photos/captions across page breaks. Enumerate bounded existing assertions separately from numeric/classification/use-case gaps repaired in the subsequent checkpoint. Existing whole links remain, but this audit does not certify full source coverage. Six implementations are bound to exact paragraph IDs and their revision evidence; no human or full-source approval follows.

sourceVisualReview.scope: Mixer; horizontal-net caption; wheelbarrow/cart/forklift; rope/shackle/turnbuckle/chain device; lifeline tensioner; stepladder; portable platform; broom/dustpan/blower inspected. Captions do not prove all-model geometry, ratings, protective equipment compliance, site stability or operation. No source numerical tables in selected entries; explicit100V/75degree/2m text is now bound to repaired paragraphs below.

freshPrimaryAccessLimits: Fresh selected official/manufacturer texts only. Search failures/empty find results were not treated as proof of absence. Whole catalogs/manuals, structural/forestry plans, legal completeness and professional approval remain open.
remaining: Six specified text gaps repaired; target display/persistence results recorded in separate QA reports. No global source-atom denominator or whole-image sufficiency approval. Remaining canonical lessons, reverse source-atom reconciliation and human review stay open.
